measurement.elapsed: Guest wall time from each ready dispatcher's start mark through the two serial revisions and dispatcher end.
measurement.revision: Each revision has two cumulative cgroup usage_usec reads. Their difference includes concurrent HTTP and other work in that builder cgroup.
measurement.residual: Dispatcher wall time minus the two marked cgroup CPU intervals. It includes waiting and work elsewhere or outside the sampled parts, including go list and receipt generation.
measurement.counterfactuals: Arithmetic on measured intervals. The aligned start holds each observed elapsed time fixed. The removed last result keeps the other seven native finishes and the observed peer batch.
measurement.independence: Four windows per native boot. The two native boots share the same OrbStack comparison boot.
